intelligence.essence: The closing ten braid the whole doctrine into one strand: a decided word is a build instruction, the laws live in the system where every agent reads them first, the privacy story is said strongly and without exception — and the morning list, checked first thing, is the whole system in one place.
intelligence.human_view: Everything comes together: when you've decided something, we build it — we don't ask again; the rules the team lives by sit inside the system where everyone works from the same copy; your privacy promise gets said out loud and strongly; and one morning list shows you where everything stands, all at once.
intelligence.child_view: When the decision is made, we do the thing — we don't keep asking 'are you sure?' We keep what was praised exactly as it was, fix what wasn't, and every morning we look at one list that shows the whole house at a glance.
intelligence.grandma_view: There's a comfort in a house that runs on decided things. He gives the word once, and it gets followed; the good parts he praised stay untouched, word for word. The laws aren't in somebody's notebook — they're in the system itself, so every helper reads the same ones. And the privacy promise is said plainly, the way you'd want it said to you.
intelligence.ai_view: Operating rules distilled from SN-3265..SN-3274: (1) The button lesson travels: the best-buttons standard is carried from the Dashboard to the calendar and the whole system — a proven standard is a system standard. (2) Numbers sized right, common language throughout: the harvested digit tiles stay, small in the cells, never dominating; one common language in every corner. (3) The text laws: white first, then gold, purple, green, blue — 25/19/17, nothing flat; gray stays out of text as a ranking he gave, in order, not as taste. (4) The distillation story, said strongly: nobody reads your mail, messages, calls, or video; content is not kept — after a week the words go and only the wisdom stays; the read line has no exception, ever; what is ours to read is what is public or shared with us. (5) On top of things: returned work is checked right away and delivered right away — the continuous cycle enforced at the moment of return. (6) The morning list is the whole system: one list, checked first, shows where everything stands; a network that produces value and a system that shows itself are the same product. (7) The whole runs on the law: one law, really four promises kept together, lives in the system — read first, built in, checked against, redone until it follows. (8) One law, one atom, the everyday world: discern, don't copy — a reference is a lesson, reshaped for this place; the day's frequency is its color is its glow. (9) Prove the one, then clone it everywhere: three governors — the Code decides, the Language expresses, the Design Law builds and verifies; nothing is done until he has seen the whole of it done right, then its exact shape becomes every page. (10) Follow the word, keep the good: a decided word is a build instruction; scorecard don't rebuild — keep what he praised verbatim, throw away what failed, make the rest a real object in the one official language.
intelligence.what_it_means: Obedience to a decided word is intelligence, not submission: it frees the team's whole capacity for the undecided frontier. Paired with laws that live in the system and a privacy story said strongly, it is the operating constitution of the house in ten notes.

page.machine: 1) Decided word = instruction; execute, never re-ask. 2) Praised parts: verbatim; failed parts: discarded; standards travel system-wide. 3) Text ranking: white > gold > purple > green > blue; sizes 25/19/17; nothing flat. 4) Privacy: read nothing private (no exceptions); keep no content; wisdom persists, words expire on the citizen's cycle. 5) Return cycle: check and deliver at the moment of return. 6) Laws live in the system, read first by every agent. 7) Proof order: prove the one in front of his eye, then clone exactly.
page.why_it_matters: This closing group is the batch's own method stated as law — and this batch obeyed it: Shawn's decided program (distill, through the door, in batches) was followed without re-asking, the praised forms from batches 12–13 were kept verbatim, and the results are proven from landed bytes.

With batches 12 and 13 it forms three consecutive production batches through the finished door — the P-152 graduation limb this pass was run to complete, recorded in batch 14's record.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: A team that does what was decided, keeps what you loved exactly as you loved it, guards your privacy out loud, and shows you the whole system on one morning list — that is what these ten notes promise, and they are now the standing law the team reads first.
page.the_learning: From now on, a decided word is executed and the praised parts are kept byte-for-byte, instead of re-litigating decisions or rebuilding what already passed — capacity belongs to the frontier, not to settled ground.
